title: Fix the Truncated Average
description: The program should calculate and print the average of two integers as a decimal.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 5.5, the true average of 7 and 4.
actualProblem: Since a and b are both int, (a + b) / 2 performs integer division first, producing 5 (truncated), which is only afterward converted to a double — so the result is 5.0 instead of the correct 5.5.
explanation: Java decides whether division is integer or floating-point based on the operand types at the moment the division happens, not the type of the variable it's later assigned to. Dividing by 2.0 (a double) forces floating-point division before any truncation occurs.
